scope: Real procurement decision observations from retrievable Gmail/GitHub evidence. Human decisions are inferred only from executed outbound actions or explicit sent-position statements. Final commercial outcomes remain null unless contract/order evidence exists.

observations.evidence_note: Rev.1.2 was sent as controlling basis and suppliers were asked to continue engineering evaluation rather than being finally selected.
Received quotations were full production-line scopes; outbound clarification explicitly kept evaluation open for requested narrower/alternative scopes.
OMS stated a specific import permit requirement; outbound response explicitly kept authorization/compliance under internal verification before commercial discussion.
BPC referred the Iranian-market route to OMS; the route was pursued and produced a substantive OMS commercial reply. This is a reply-stage success, not an order/contract success.
SupplierTR confirmed engineering evaluation and later confirmed Rev.1.2 as controlling basis; no final OEM/compliance qualification or order evidence exists.
